purpose: Prevent external-event association studies from conflating event absence with missing event data, or observation absence with an observed zero.

allowed_roles: attribution test if spatial/temporal geometry is compatible
EVENT_OBSERVED.example_semantics: A rocket/balloon/flare is established on a date and Palomar or a human-reporting channel has an actual observation opportunity.

EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED.example_semantics: Bumper or Strato-Lab event exists but Palomar did not observe the relevant date/window.

requirements: External manifest must be complete enough to establish the no-event state for that date/interval.
Observation channel must have actual opportunity.
NO_EVENT_OBSERVED.example_semantics: A solar flare-patrol-qualified day with no official event, combined with an actually observed Palomar night.

EVENT_STATE_UNKNOWN.example_semantics: NASA sounding-rocket catalogue contains scientifically successful rockets; absence of a row cannot establish no launch.

admission_algorithm: 1. Establish external event state from a source with explicit population/completeness semantics.
2. Independently establish observation opportunity in the target channel.
3. Do not coerce UNKNOWN external state to NO_EVENT.
4. Do not coerce NOT_OBSERVED target state to observed zero.
5. Only EVENT_OBSERVED and NO_EVENT_OBSERVED may enter an exposed/unexposed rate comparison.
6. For human-made physical attribution additionally require geography/trajectory and within-day ordering where available.
7. If the target channel is dense/saturated, model rate/morphology conditional on observation rather than binary any-event presence.

lineage_lessons.lesson: ANY_CANDIDATE became exactly PALOMAR_OBSERVED_NIGHT in the dense S0 cohort; encoding unobserved days as zero generated the nominal nuclear association.
NOAA flare-patrol opportunity was required before a no-flare date could become a legitimate solar negative.
A real human-made event can be unusable for POSS attribution when Palomar did not observe; date-only Blue Book coincidences collapse when geography or ordering is incompatible.
Operational prose or positive-only catalogues cannot manufacture negative event dates.
